counterargs.read: Today reads as a continuation/acceleration of yesterday's constructive tape rather than a new catalyst: Korea/memory reversed hard higher, oil extended its slide, and nominal yields eased again with breakevens soft. The Korea gate improved to 2/3 (EWY back above its 20-day average) but KOSPI remains far below the 8,200 structural threshold, so the gate stays closed. MOVE easing from 83 to 80.5 is directionally positive but the bond-vol stress flag (>80) hasn't fully cleared. Net: genuine breadth improvement in semis/Korea, but two structural conditions (Korea gate, MOVE>80) keep conviction at medium rather than high.
